meta.title: cbct-segmentation · Hand-Rolled LRO Front, GPU Worker, Storage Tier
meta.subtitle: MLE · system dia · the only GPU workload in the fleet

views.label: A front built by hand
views.note: This front does not call lro.SetupHandler. It wires config, auth, background tasks and a message queue itself.

views.label: The GPU pod
views.note: The only MLE pod that tolerates nodeType mle_gpu and requests an NVIDIA GPU. It deploys with Recreate, not RollingUpdate.

views.label: A dedicated storage tier
views.note: cbct-segmentation-storage is its own gRPC service. It is the only storage tier MLE monitors; tooth-modeling-storage has no monitor.

cards.title: One of two hand-rolled fronts
items: It skips lro.SetupHandler and wires config, auth and background tasks by hand
It rides pkg/postgres-lro in this repo, not the external DS-DP-S/postgres-lro module
tooth-modeling-broker is the only other MLE front built this way

cards.title: The only GPU workload in MLE
items: The pod tolerates nodeType mle_gpu and nvidia.com/gpu, unlike every other MLE pod
The sidecar limit block asks for nvidia.com/gpu: 1 alongside 5 CPU
Deployment strategy is Recreate, because two pods cannot share one GPU

cards.title: Compute over HTTP, not gRPC
items: The worker calls api-clients-go over HTTPS with a 3 minute client timeout
Every other MLE worker speaks gRPC to localhost:50071 instead
The image is digest pinned at 20250204@sha256:af1a512a, the only digest pin in MLE

cards.title: Two things worth a second look
items: The sidecar limits CPU to 5 but sets no memory limit, while requesting 25Gi
That same drift exists in parl-detection-worker and nowhere else
The container is named cbct-segmentation-compute but runs the anatomy-segmentation image
